components.description: Deep forest floating bar with two tabs and a raised mint scan button.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 340px; height: 68px; padding: 0 16px; margin-top: 30px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 32px; background: #0A3328; box-shadow: 0px 10px 24px rgba(10,51,40,0.28); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 48px; border: none; background: none; color: #A9D9C2; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-on { color: #3DDC97; } .ds-tab:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-gap { width: 80px; } .ds-scan { position: absolute; top: -22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 999px; border: 4px solid #F3FCF8; background: #3DDC97; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0px 10px 24px rgba(10,51,40,0.28); cursor: pointer; } .ds-scan:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-scan:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3DDC97; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Book covers are the product, and the system exists to display them. Each cover rests on a pale mint plate, like a bookshop window, while every action (reserve, search, scan, confirm) is marked by deep forest green. Mint itself is the spark: it appears on the active tab, the raised scan button, and a highlighted figure, never as a large fill. The reference the student supplied was a mint/green mobile shop UI, and the build keeps its grammar: rounded white cards over a tinted canvas, pill buttons, and a floating dark bar with a raised centre button.

The mood is calm, fresh and tidy. Density is low to medium: a two-column shelf of cards, large touch targets (48px minimum, buttons 56px), generous 16 to 24px gutters. Depth is soft and tinted green, never grey or hard. All copy is clear Argentine Spanish (voseo) addressed to the student.

The course imposes hard structural rules that shape the code: every colour, size and spacing value lives in src/constants/tema.ts, styles use StyleSheet.create only, and no inline styles. Any new surface must add to tema.ts first.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green for actions, mint for emphasis, mint plate for covers.
Pill-shaped buttons and circular icon actions; cards at a 24px radius.
Soft green-tinted shadows; no borders on cards.
Floating tab bar with a raised centre scan action.
Platform system font, bold titles, small tight scale.
Pressed state is a uniform 0.75 opacity.

rules.name: The Forest Commits Rule
rules.body: Anything that does something (reserve, search, confirm, filter on) is forest green. Mint never carries an action fill except the scan button.

rules.name: The Mint Spark Rule
rules.body: Mint (#3DDC97) is an accent on dark forest surfaces, never text on a light surface and never a large fill.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans green. No pure grey and no pure black outside the camera.

rules.name: The Bold Title, Quiet Caption Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by weight pairs (700 against 400/600), not by extra families or letter-spaced capitals.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Counts and numerals set in tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Green Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted forest or ink at low opacity and offset downward. No grey or hard-edged shadows.

rules.name: The Gradient Is for Two Things Rule
rules.body: Gradients appear only on the hero banner (forest to mint, 135deg) and the cover plate (white to mint plate, 160deg).

dos: Do add any new colour, size or spacing to src/constants/tema.ts and reference it; style with StyleSheet.create only.
Do place every book cover on the mint plate and give it the Cover shadow.
Do make interactive elements forest green and at least 48px (buttons 56px).
Do tint every shadow with forest or ink at low opacity.
Do give icon-only controls an accessibilityLabel and buttons accessibilityRole="button".
Do keep copy in clear Argentine Spanish and explain failures with a visible way forward.
donts: Don't use mint (#3DDC97) as a text colour on light surfaces or as a large fill.
Don't add pure grey, pure black (outside the camera) or hard-edged shadows.
Don't introduce rectangular buttons; actions are pills or circles.
Don't put gradients on anything but the hero banner and the cover plate.
Don't rely on cover images alone; every cover needs the typographic fallback.
Don't use inline styles or hard-coded values in components.
